verdict.rationale: Vercel Agent is a first-party AI assistant built into the Vercel dashboard. It draws on the user's own projects, deployments, logs, metrics, configuration and usage to investigate production issues, review code and propose changes, so it directly provides in-product AI insights from user data. However, it is documented as public beta and limited to Pro and Enterprise teams, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: general availability on all plans, detail on proactive insight or suggestion surfaces beyond chat, Investigations and Code Review, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Vercel Agent uses context from your Vercel projects, deployments, logs, metrics, configuration, usage, and connected repositories.
Chat in Slack, dashboard chat, Investigations, and Code Review are in public beta for Pro and Enterprise teams.
Vercel Agent is an AI assistant built into Vercel. Use it to understand your projects, investigate production issues, review code, and take approved actions.
